Hey Axie fam and web3 gamers! 👋 
If you’re ready for the next evolution in blockchain gaming, buckle up because Axie Infinity: Atia’s Legacy is here to redefine play-to-earn adventures! 

Built on the lightning-fast Ronin Network, this massively multiplayer online (MMO) game is set to launch its first alpha playtest this summer 2025. 🐉✨

Imagine leading a squad of up to four adorable yet fierce Axies through the war-torn world of Lunacia—a once-vibrant realm now filled with ancient ruins, hidden treasures, and mystical secrets waiting to be uncovered. 🌍💎 

In Atia’s Legacy, you’ll farm resources, engage in squad-based combat, complete thrilling quests, and dive into player-versus-environment (PvE) battles that test your strategy and teamwork. Whether you’re crafting epic gear or coordinating with friends for guild wars, every action feels immersive and rewarding! 🎮⚔️

What makes this game a game-changer? It’s powered by the Ronin Network, Sky Mavis’ Ethereum sidechain designed specifically for gaming. 
Ronin offers ultra-low fees, seamless transactions, and true ownership of your in-game assets via NFTs. 
No more gas wars or laggy experiences— just pure, fluid fun! 🚀💨 
Plus, Atia’s Legacy integrates perfectly with the existing Axie economy, giving your beloved Axie NFTs a fresh purpose. Breed, battle, and build your legacy while earning AXS and other tokens through play. 

Your Axies aren’t just collectibles; they’re your army in this open-world MMO! 🦊🔥
Sky Mavis has learned from past “scar tissue” to create something truly special. Cross-platform from day one—play on mobile, PC, or wherever you roam. 
Social features let you chat, team up, and conquer together, fostering a vibrant community like never before. And with Ronin’s recent “Open Ronin” initiative, developers worldwide are flocking to build on this chain, accelerating growth and innovation. 📈🌐

The Philippines, a hotspot for Axie players, is already buzzing with meetups in cities like Manila and Cebu—join the global rally! 🇵🇭👥
But the hype doesn’t stop there! 

Pre-registration is live now, and it’s packed with rewards. 
Head to the official site to sign up and snag your spot in the first generation of players. 🎟️ 
Refer friends for bonus points: S-Tier for those with Ronin transaction history since 2021! Plus, check out the Ronin Wallet Bounties—complete simple quests like reposting the trailer on X or joining the Axie Discord to earn 0.25 AXS each (first 80,000 users only!). ⏰💰 

Watch the epic trailer and feel the excitement: Atia’s Legacy Trailer. 
Don’t miss the Bounty Board quests for Premier Tickets too!
